UGREEN MM103 HDMI to VGA with Audio Converter – High-Performance Display Adapter


Easily connect your HDMI-enabled devices to VGA displays with the UGREEN MM103 HDMI to VGA Converter with Audio support. This high-quality adapter allows you to transmit HD video signals from laptops, desktops, gaming consoles, or media players to VGA projectors, monitors, or TVs. It also features a 3.5mm audio output, ensuring both video and audio transmission for a complete viewing experience. With plug-and-play convenience and durable build quality, it’s the ideal solution for business presentations, classroom setups, and home entertainment.
